# FuboTV: It's Just FuboTV

A FuboTV hockey player skates toward the camera, delivers a deal line, and finishes with a hard stop that sprays ice before skating away.

## Panel 1 — FuboTV Player Skates In
Image: The setting is a modern indoor hockey arena, with a white ice rink, boards and glass barriers, FuboTV logos on the rink sides and digital banners on the bleachers, bright overhead lights, and cheering crowds in the stands. FuboTV hockey player is a man in his late twenties, athletic build, light skin, short brown hair, wearing a reddish-orange and white hockey jersey with a large FuboTV logo on the chest, white pants, black skates, and a white helmet with a clear visor. A hockey player skates toward the camera, face lit and in frame, across a rink with FuboTV logos on the boards and digital banners in the stands, cheering crowds in the background, cool ice tones with warm lighting, medium close-up, realistic cinematic style. FuboTV hockey player faces the camera. The shot is a medium shot.
Motion: The FuboTV hockey player skates forward toward the camera, his face toward the lens, in frame and lit as he speaks. FuboTV hockey player faces the camera. The camera tracks alongside the movement.
Dialogue: FuboTV hockey player: Getting the best deal on hockey isn't a hat trick...

## Panel 2 — Hockey Stop and Sign-Off
Motion: The FuboTV hockey player carves a sharp stop, spraying ice mist into the air, his face toward the lens, then pushes off and skates away from the camera. The camera holds on him as he recedes. FuboTV hockey player faces the camera. The camera stays static.
Dialogue: FuboTV hockey player: It's just FuboTV.
